elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: The cap applies to “each Party's aggregate liability to the other Parties,” making it mutual.

elements.element: The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The cap uses twelve months of Capital Costs and O&M Costs paid or payable, but includes neither a USD 1,000,000 floor nor a greater-of formulation.

elements.element: The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Paragraph 21.3 provides that no Party is liable to any other Party for the specified indirect or consequential losses.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Breach of Paragraph 31 (Confidentiality) is expressly excluded from the aggregate cap, with “no limit” applying.

elements.element: Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: There is no carve-out for data protection or security obligations.
A Party's indemnification obligations are expressly excluded from the aggregate cap, with “no limit” applying.
Gross negligence is expressly excluded from the aggregate cap, with “no limit” applying.
Wilful misconduct is expressly excluded from the aggregate cap, with “no limit” applying.
Fraud is not included among the uncapped carve-outs.

elements.element: Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Infringement of another Party's intellectual property is not included among the uncapped carve-outs.

elements.element: Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
elements.evidence: The clause does not state that payment obligations are not damages or otherwise exclude them from the cap.
